Jakub Novak has been a consistent contributor to CloudFlow’s QA initiatives since joining as a Senior QA Engineer. His work on API testing architectures has been pivotal, particularly in redesigning the integration layer to handle 15k+ endpoints with 99.8% coverage. He’s also spearheaded test automation frameworks that cut regression cycles by 40%, using Python to build reusable modules across microservices.  

Soft skills-wise, Jakub thrives in collaborative settings. He’s patiently mentored junior engineers on BDD/TDD practices, which reduced manual test cases by 30% in two major projects. His ability to translate complex system requirements into clear test scenarios has minimized miscommunication during cross-team sprints.  

Jakub’s impact extends beyond code. He led a performance testing overhaul using k6, identifying bottlenecks that improved system scalability by 25%. His strategic approach to test strategy design—aligning automation with business priorities—has become a reference point for teams.  

As a peer, I’ve observed his relentless attention to detail and willingness to iterate. He’ll often spend hours refining test data pipelines or debugging edge cases, even when under tight deadlines. These traits make him a dependable asset to any team. I’d confidently recommend him for roles requiring both technical depth and collaborative leadership.
